description: This file defines a 'ResetDatabaseController' class responsible for handling requests to reset the database to its initial state in the context of functional testing for OrangeHRM. It implements a handle method that restores the database and returns the number of tables affected as a JSON response.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseController
classes.description: Controller class that handles database reset requests during functional testing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to reset the database and returns a JSON response with the count of tables restored.
